hero.title: Roasting, flavor and quality control at every stage
hero.subtitle: A smile, enjoyment and energy — you'll find all of it in a single cup of our coffee

products.description: A balanced 100% arabica coffee with a soft, expressive profile. Medium roast reveals creamy and nutty notes, making the taste rich, while low acidity delivers a smooth aftertaste

office.title: The perfect format for home and office
office.body1: Premium 3-in-1 instant coffee in a 20-sachet pack — a convenient solution for everyday use
office.body2: This format suits large families, work teams and companies, while individual sachets simplify storage and preparation

searched.title: The coffee you were looking for
searched.body1: We carefully select coffee beans to preserve their natural character and flavor.
searched.body2: Control at every stage and gentle roasting reveal a soft, balanced profile without excess bitterness. Everything so your cup delivers exactly the taste you'll want to return to.

capacity.title: Modern production capacity
capacity.body1: Our facility is equipped with modern roasting and packaging lines built to process significant volumes of green coffee, with particular focus on the specialty and premium segments.
capacity.body2: Our production capacity lets us work with different roast profiles — from light and delicate for specialty coffee to rich and deep for espresso blends. We built our production so scale never gets in the way of precision, and every batch meets strict quality standards.

organic.title: 100% organic product
organic.body1: Our products are based on organic coffee raw material, grown without artificial additives or aggressive processing methods. We adhere to the principles of clean composition and transparent ingredient origins.
organic.body2: The organic approach makes the product suitable for regular consumption and preserves the natural properties of coffee without excessive interference.

italian.title: Italian roast and flavor balance
italian.body1: Coffee is roasted to Italian standards, with the emphasis on flavor balance and careful development of the bean. This approach avoids excessive bitterness, preserves the purity of the flavor profile and delivers a clear, comfortable taste.
italian.body2: Italian roasting works well for both whole-bean coffee and instant formats, delivering a clear and comfortable flavor for everyday use.

certified.title: Certified production
certified.body1: Our production processes comply with international ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 22000:2018 standards, confirming a systematic approach to quality management and food safety at every stage.
certified.body2: Additional Halal certification reflects responsibility across all production stages and makes the product accessible and suitable for a wide audience.

hero.title: About us
hero.subtitle: The story, standards and team behind NesilCoffee.

welcome.title: Welcome to NesilCoffee
welcome.sideTitle: Created with passion, perfected with care
welcome.sideBody: NesilCoffee's 100% organic beans, sourced from more than 15 countries, tell a story of the very best that nature has to offer.

geography.title: From the misty highlands of Ethiopia to the sun-drenched slopes of Colombia
geography.body1: Every bean is hand-picked on chemical-free plantations set against breathtaking landscapes.
geography.body2: Roasted with Italian craftsmanship and certified organic, NesilCoffee weaves together aromas — Guatemala's smoky depth, Indonesia's earthy chocolate and Rwanda's floral notes — into a rich cup made with care for the environment.
geography.body3: Set against majestic mountains, NesilCoffee delivers a whole symphony of flavor with every sip tasting of respect for nature.

step1.title: Sourcing
step1.body: NesilCoffee's quality is built at every stage — from sourcing to shipping the finished product. We work only with pre-selected raw material — green coffee beans and 3-in-1 drink ingredients — chosen from the outset against NesilCoffee's approved specifications and recipes.

step2.title: Development and testing
step2.body: Before production starts, raw material undergoes a quality and condition check confirming its characteristics and readiness for use. Our in-house R&D and QC team creates and evolves the range: specialists build recipes, fine-tune the balance of flavor and aroma, test products and approve compositions, ensuring stability and a recognizable flavor for every SKU.

step3.title: Quality control
step3.body: During production and before shipment, the finished product passes a final check — roast and blend quality, packaging integrity, labeling accuracy and compliance with established standards. Only after quality is confirmed does the product move to the warehouse and on to our clients.

experts.title: Our experts share the principles and approach behind our production

one.name: Eziz Myradov
one.quote: «Every bean, every roast profile, every pack is the result of the attention, technology and experience of the NesilCoffee team. That's how we get coffee we're proud to offer our customers.»

two.name: Bayramguly Gurbangulyev
two.role: Head of quality control and R&D
two.quote: «NesilCoffee is a considered approach to the quality of every product. We tightly control every stage of production to guarantee stable flavor and a high standard in every batch.»

idea.title: The idea
idea.body: At the heart of Turkmenistan, on the sun-drenched plains of Ashgabat, NesilCoffee was born with the goal of creating 100% organic coffee.

search.title: The search
search.body: We sought out the best green-bean suppliers and world-class equipment to build a production facility that meets international quality standards.

roast.title: The roast
roast.body: Our technologists developed signature roast profiles that bring out the best notes of every origin — from a light Scandinavian to a dark Italian.

launch.title: The launch
launch.body: The first batches of NesilCoffee went out to our partners — from major retail chains to HoReCa and corporate clients — winning over Central Asian markets.

items.a: The minimum wholesale order is discussed individually depending on the product and logistics. Contact us for an exact quote.

items.q: Do you only work with wholesale orders?
items.a: Yes, NesilCoffee operates B2B and focuses on wholesale supply. We work with distributors, retail chains, HoReCa, corporate clients and export partners.
We work with trusted logistics operators. Delivery terms are agreed individually, including exports.
Payment terms are discussed individually with each partner and set out in the contract.
A full document package for the product: quality certificates, HALAL, ISO, delivery notes, invoices, export documents.

items.q: Can I get a price list?
items.a: Yes — the current price list is sent on request after a short intro to your business. Fill out the form below.
